claim: For AWS managed endpoints (AWS Lambda and Amazon SQS), the SNS delivery policy makes 100,015 attempts in total, over 23 days: 3 immediate retries, 2 pre-backoff retries 1 second apart, 10 backoff retries from 1 second to 20 seconds, and 100,000 post-backoff retries 20 seconds apart.
question: SNS delivery retries: policy for AWS-managed endpoints (SQS, Lambda, Firehose): number of attempts and time span?

qualifiers.scope: per message delivery to an AWS managed endpoint (Lambda, SQS)
qualifiers.condition: Only HTTP/S delivery policies can be changed.

evidence.quote: Immediate retry (no delay) phase: 3 times, without delay Pre-backoff phase: 2 times, 1 second apart Backoff phase: 10 times, with exponential backoff, from 1 second to 20 seconds Post-backoff phase: 100,000 times, 20 seconds apart Total attempts: 100,015 times, over 23 days
